name: liquid-glass
label: Liquid Glass
vibe: Frosted premium airiness. Panels feel like physical glass floating over the footage. Slow, expensive motion.

motion.notes: Slow luxury glide, zero overshoot. Panels drift gently while on screen (2px parallax, 8s loop). Nothing snaps.

componentAccents.textOnScreen: compact slim frosted glass pill, small white text, single line, bottom-center
componentAccents.ctaBanner: glass pill with ice blue glowing edge
componentAccents.subscribe: YouTube red button (functional color, overrides accent) + frosted glass bell chip, cursor click animation
componentAccents.conceptSplitPanel: full-height frosted glass side panel with a bright right edge, eyebrow dot label, stacked glass strike rows
componentAccents.concept75Field: deep charcoal blue-black field with subtle grid and an ice blue aurora sweep, footage in a rounded portrait card with a thin bright edge, wide glass rows
componentAccents.conceptFullScreen: frosted glass cards with glowing edges over the fullscreenBackground, ice gradient line icons

fullscreenBackground: deep charcoal blue-black textured background, subtle grid, soft ice blue aurora glow sweeping from a top corner, gentle film grain
